articles.title: NASA's Lithium Plasma Thruster Passes Record Test, Paving the Way to Mars
articles.summary: NASA fired a lithium-fed magnetoplasmadynamic thruster at 120 kilowatts—the highest power ever for a U.S. electric propulsion system. The test marks a crucial step toward engines that could slash travel time for human Mars missions.

articles.title: Accidental Discovery: Pond Organism Breaks the Universal Genetic Code
articles.summary: A single-celled protist from an Oxford pond reassigned two stop codons to different amino acids—a combination never before observed. The finding challenges the assumption that the genetic code is nearly universal.

articles.title: Clear Nail Polish Could Turn Long Nails into Touchscreen Styluses
articles.summary: Researchers have developed a clear nail polish containing taurine that disrupts a touchscreen's electric field, allowing long nails to register as a touch. The innovation could end the struggle of typing with long nails.
